5_hygiene.method_blue: W182c blue_compare(a87e195 typeset, HEAD typeset) gives each HEAD token a status; a token is listed when its status is new / rewritten / unwrapped / moved_unwrapped, it holds content (a letter or digit left after structural commands with their arguments and other control-word names are removed), and under half of its alphanumeric characters (control-word names excluded) are inside a \textcolor{blue} wrapper; a token inside a 6-token run that occurs anywhere at a87e195 is "moved verbatim", else "newly written"; class from the environments open at the line (scan from the top); captions by W182c caption_blue on every float label

6_counts.counting_rule: comment-stripped source (W167 strip_comments); regions: main text = \section{Introduction} .. \appendix; Appendix A = its \section .. the next appendix \section; Appendix B = its \section .. the unnumbered declaration section (or \bibliography); abstract counted apart; float environments (table, figure, longtable, algorithm, starred forms) removed and their \caption words counted apart; display math (equation, align, gather, multline, eqnarray, displaymath, subequations content) removed; inline math ($..$, $$..$$, \(..\), \[..\]) removed; heading titles removed and counted apart; arguments of \ref, \eqref, \cite*, \label, \url, \includegraphics, \begin, \end, \hspace, \vspace and the colour argument of \textcolor removed; every other control word removed with the text of its arguments kept; braces, ~ and escaped characters become spaces; a word is a whitespace-separated token holding a letter or digit (hyphenated compounds count once)
